question_text: Which hormone is commonly known as fight and flight hormone?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The hormones
steps.why: They prepare the body for sudden effort, which is either to fight or to run away.
common_mistakes: Naming cortisol. That is the stress hormone of the cortex, not the emergency one.
Giving only one of the two names.
steps.memory_tip: Adrenaline and noradrenaline, also called epinephrine and norepinephrine.

steps.label: Where they come from
steps.why: The medulla is nerve tissue, so it can pour out its hormones the instant a nerve signal arrives.
common_mistakes: Naming the adrenal cortex. These come from the medulla.
steps.memory_tip: Medulla is the inner part of the adrenal gland.
steps.margin_note: Name the exact part of the gland.

lines.text: They are secreted by the adrenal medulla

insider_note: Two hormones are named, not one. Give both, and name the adrenal medulla as their source.
